card.name: Linking words before increased-risk phrases
card.fires_on: The small word "at" in "are at increased/high risk" after a patient group, and similar spots such as "risk of" or a space after "greater than" before a risk figure. It appears in warnings about risk.

modes.label: "are at" risk

card.writes: It seems to push toward words for a rate or risk level, such as "rate is" or "rate reached" (some in Chinese).
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before a warning says a group is at higher risk.
